**Preheat {{VERSION}}**, released {{DATE}}

Cuts the freeze at portals with Iris shaders by preparing every dimension ahead of time. It needs Java 25, [Iris](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) and Sodium on Minecraft 26.2 or 26.3, with Fabric or NeoForge.

## Install

1. Download `preheat-{{VERSION}}+mc26.3.jar` for Minecraft 26.3 or `preheat-{{VERSION}}+mc26.2.jar` for 26.2 below. Each works on Fabric and NeoForge.
2. Put it in your game's `mods` folder next to Iris, replacing any older Preheat jar.
3. Start the game.

Your settings and saved shaders are kept when you upgrade. Each `.sha256` file holds its jar's checksum. If something isn't working, see [troubleshooting](https://github.com/lewisgibson/preheat/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md).
